title: The dance I joined by accident

beats.text: On one such occasion, I chose to wear an entirely black outfit—I didn't know why—complete with black shoes, black pants, a black shirt, and my hair in a ponytail.
beats.prompt: a woman dressing all in black, pulling her hair into a ponytail

src.prompt: a brown-haired woman dressing all in black, pulling her hair into a ponytail in front of a freestanding oval mirror with a wooden frame
a woman dressing all in black, pulling her hair into a ponytail

beats.text: My roommates led me to some event performance that I didn't know a thing about.
beats.prompt: roommates leading her out into the night to something she knows nothing about

src.prompt: roommates in ordinary colourful clothes leading the brown-haired woman in black out into the night
roommates leading her out into the night to something she knows nothing about

beats.text: When we got there, I ended up sitting in the front row, which was actually just the floor, in front of a bunch of folding chairs.
beats.prompt: sitting alone on the floor in front of a row of folding chairs

src.prompt: the brown-haired woman in black sitting alone on the floor in front of rows of folding chairs filled with an audience in ordinary clothes
sitting alone on the floor in front of a row of folding chairs

beats.text: When the performance started, it was just two women performing some modern dance, which was mainly just grappling with each other, sort of falling all over each other in rough, seemingly unchoreographed motions.
beats.prompt: two women in black grappling and falling over each other on a bare stage

src.prompt: two dancers in black grappling and falling over each other, ringed by a crowd sitting on the floor all around them
two women in black grappling and falling over each other on a bare stage

beats.text: I noted that they were wearing all black, and that I also was wearing all black.
beats.prompt: she looks down at her own black clothes while the dancers pass

src.prompt: the brown-haired woman in black, ponytail, looking down at her own clothes as the dancers pass
she looks down at her own black clothes while the dancers pass

beats.text: The situation seemed to be a dare, which I eventually carried out without needing even to stand.
beats.prompt: a dare passing between friends across a dark room

src.prompt: the brown-haired woman alone in the dark crowd, looking up into a shaft of light, daring it
a dare passing between friends across a dark room

beats.text: I sort of rolled away from the audience and into the performance.
beats.prompt: she rolls out of the audience into the performance

src.prompt: the brown-haired woman in black, ponytail, rolling out of the audience into the performance
she rolls out of the audience into the performance

beats.text: I had braced myself for any outcome, but the performers, who looked exactly like me, embraced my appearance without a second thought, as though it had been planned, and soon I was grappling with them on stage, and two became three.
beats.prompt: three women who look exactly alike tangled together on stage

src.prompt: three identical brown-haired dancers in black, ponytails and black shoes, tangled together on stage
three women who look exactly alike tangled together on stage

beats.text: And after it was over, everybody clapped, and no one except my roommates were the wiser.
beats.prompt: an audience applauding three dancers, nobody the wiser

src.prompt: an audience in ordinary colourful clothes applauding three dancers in black, nobody the wiser
an audience applauding three dancers, nobody the wiser
